description.en: Planned whole-organism study featuring back-curving paired head horns arch over a compact body ringed by long lateral spines.
description.zh: 拟议全体生物研究：成对后弯头角拱过紧凑身体，体缘布长侧刺。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level planning study grounded in a named taxon source; reconstructed or simplified components remain artistic interpretations.
scientific_scope.zh: 依据具名分类单元来源进行属级规划；补全及简化结构仍属于复原或美术解释。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is back-curving paired head horns arch over a compact body ringed by long lateral spines; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以成对后弯头角拱过紧凑身体，体缘布长侧刺为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish back-curving paired head horns arch over a compact body ringed by long lateral spines in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以成对后弯头角拱过紧凑身体，体缘布长侧刺搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

uncertainty: Named source supports the principal form. Species-level dimensions, missing structures and soft tissues still require a selected specimen reference.
reference_notes: Dicranurus hamatus elegantus, PDF page 31, Devonian; paired curved horns. No exact coexistence is implied.

sources.title: Trilobite Hall of Fame: Best of the Best
sources.supports: Asaphus long eye stalks (PDF p13), Dicranurus curved horns (p31), Erbenochile enlarged eyes (p38); named specimen ages. Other pictured taxa remain gated unless their forms are individually matched.
